capabilities.name: read balance

capabilities.name: hidden accounts (exclude from totals)

capabilities.name: joint vs individual views
capabilities.note: Owner filter: the partner's view holds only accounts they own (joint), totals follow.

capabilities.name: closed account detection
capabilities.note: closedCandidates: connector-closed, or zero balance with no activity in 90 days; action is confirm-and-hide.

capabilities.name: duplicate account dedup
capabilities.note: duplicates/dedupe: same institution, kind and last digits across connectors count once.

capabilities.name: balance history and trend
capabilities.note: balanceHistory from dated snapshots with a 30-day trend (delta and direction).

capabilities.name: cash position across all liquid accounts
capabilities.note: cashPosition: liquid USD accounts only, balance and available, ids listed.
capabilities.description: cash position across all liquid accounts

capabilities.name: list transactions with filters
capabilities.note: list: account, date window, category, min/max cents, pending, merchant filters over enriched rows.

capabilities.name: search by merchant, amount, date, note

capabilities.description: search by merchant, amount, date, note

capabilities.note: categorize: per-transaction override, then the user's rules, then defaults; the reason is returned with the category.

capabilities.note: normalizeMerchant: AMZN MKTP to Amazon via a display map over the monitors' merchant key; title-case fallback.

capabilities.name: duplicate charge detection
capabilities.note: Same account, merchant identity and amount within three days; two identical charges can be legitimate, so the user confirms before any refund request.

capabilities.name: pending vs posted explanation
capabilities.note: pendingVsPosted: what pending means for the available balance and why the amount can still change.

capabilities.name: CSV export
capabilities.note: csv: RFC 4180 quoting, dollars with two decimals from integer cents.

capabilities.name: refund matching to original charge
capabilities.note: A later credit is reported as a possible refund with unverified linkage until a trusted link to the original charge exists.

capabilities.name: transfer detection between own accounts
capabilities.note: transfers: opposite amounts across two own accounts within three days, paired once; excluded from spending.

capabilities.name: fee flagging (overdraft, ATM, wire, foreign)
capabilities.note: Overdraft, NSF, maintenance, ATM, foreign transaction, late and paper statement fees on retained posted USD facts; fee wording over $500 is not trusted as a fee.

capabilities.name: large transaction explanation on request
capabilities.note: explainLarge: the charge against the merchant's own history and the category's typical amount; pending noted.

capabilities.name: month-over-month comparison

capabilities.name: merchant history (all time with one merchant)

capabilities.description: merchant history (all time with one merchant)

capabilities.name: spending by category over any window
capabilities.note: spendingByCategory over any window with shares in basis points; transfers and debt payments are not spending.
capabilities.description: spending by category over any window

capabilities.name: income vs spend
capabilities.note: incomeVsSpend per month with the savings rate.

capabilities.name: budget creation per category

capabilities.name: budget pacing alerts
capabilities.note: Pacing: fixed recurring bills count once plus the ones still expected this month; only variable spend scales with the days elapsed; alert above 115 percent pace and over budget.

capabilities.name: safe-to-spend today number
capabilities.note: safeToSpend: available cash minus recurring debits due before the next expected income minus card statements due minus a buffer, every component in the sentence.

capabilities.name: cashflow forecast 30/60/90 days

capabilities.name: recurring expenses calendar

capabilities.name: subscription total run-rate
